title: Turmeric Finger & Powder
titleTag: Turmeric | Mark Overseas
shortDesc: Indian Turmeric, also known as 'Golden Spice', is famous for its high curcumin content and medicinal properties. We offer premium finger and powder variants.
description: Indian Turmeric is synonymous with premium quality, high curcumin content, and vibrant golden hue. We export varieties like Alleppey (high curcumin), Nizamabad, and Erode. Known for its powerful anti-inflammatory properties and distinct earthy flavor, it is used extensively in food processing, nutraceuticals, and cosmetics. Our Turmeric Fingers are sun-dried, polished (single/double), and checked for lead-free purity to comply with USFDA and EU norms.
